notes:
A state Cliopatria lacks (cliopatria_names []). Two pages opened (Nasrid dynasty (Sistan), Sistan; the Sistan page is shared with the mihrabanids dossier). Wikidata id not obtainable: null.
Dates: the infobox gives 1029-1225; the page's text has 'the establishment of the Nasrid Kingdom at Nimruz in 1068 until its dissolution in 1225' (not reconciled on the page); the Sistan page has Nasr founding the dynasty in 1029. The end is 1225 on both pages, but the infobox lists the Mongol Empire and the Mihrabanids as successors while the Sistan page says the Khwarezmians ended it: the loss is booked to khwarezmid-empire (whose dossier should then lose Sistan to the Mongols; see mihrabanids).
Status: 'The dynasty then became vassals of the Seljuks in 1048, Ghurids in 1162, and the Khwarezmians in 1212' (Sistan page), after being Ghaznavid vassals. The ghurid-dynasty dossier already carries the 1162 vassal_start and 1212 vassal_end with counterpart 'Nasrid maliks of Sistan'; the great-seljuk-empire 1048 vassalage and the Khwarazmian 1212-1225 vassalage are suzerain-side events not recorded here.
Territory: the 'Sistan' region only. The Saffarid end (1002, Mahmud's conquest) is in the ghaznavid-empire dossier. The rulers 1073-1225 are not on the extracted pages.
Gazetteer names used that it lacks: none.
